en: In days long past, we lived for the hunt.  We hunted for glory, for honor...$B$BIs it so different now?
The Stonehearth Graveyard is under attack!  If left unchecked, the Horde will capture it!
You look like you've had your heart broken. Come back when you're not so sad.
Our forces are ready and eager.  Soon, Balinda Stonehearth will enter her outpost and the battle will begin anew!
Don't come out of the shadows like that. Next time give a girl some warning.
The Alliance has abandoned us!
Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

Aye, I did. Much to the dismay of the lesser Mograine, I made my way back to the Scarlet Monastery. I shouted and screamed. I told the tale to any that would listen. And I would be murdered in cold blood for my actions, dragged to this chamber - the dark secret of the order. But some did listen... some heard my words. Thus was born the Argent Dawn...

Ragefire Chasm consists of a network of volcanic caverns below the orcs' new capital city of Orgrimmar. Recently, rumors have spread that a cult loyal to the demonic Shadow Council has taken up residence within the Chasm's fiery depths. This cult, known as the Burning Blade, threatens the very sovereignty of Durotar. Many believe that the orc Warchief Thrall is aware of the Blade's existence and has chosen not to destroy it in the hopes that its members might lead him straight to the Shadow Council.
Hey!  Get away from our treasure!
Invaders, cease this foolish venture at once! Turn away while you still can!
Well, I'm going outside to check. Something is amiss.
Slay them in the master's name!
Elder Bronzebeard can be found in the ancestral home of the Bronzebeards, Ironforge.
Aaahhh... Another glorious victory for The Horde!
Oh, I will, my friend. I will indeed. You, too, be safe.
The Sandfury reign supreme!
Ah, to be pulled from the dreaded nightmare! I thank you, my loyal Disciple, along with your brave companions.
They will live, if only to see the fruits of their labor: the destruction and chaos that will surely ensue as the legion of Blackrock invade the gorge.

With some of the technology that was recovered by bold gnomes venturing into Gnomeregan, I have managed to construct my greatest invention:  The Matter Transporter!    All I need now is a skilled Gnomish Engineer to build a powerful beacon attuned to the transporter.
$n!  Betrayer of Ragnaros!
Icy Scale Breastplate.
Mages too? You should be more careful when you play with magic...
Buy somethin', will ya?
I didn't mean to drag you into this, $n.  Ever since we took on a job to steal Lord Valthalak's spellbook, everyone involved has wound up dead or missing.

Watch your step, soldier. The Stormpike have littered the ground around their bases with landmines. Speak with our explosives expert in the watch tower to the east if you want information on how to diffuse their mine fields.
Yes $gsir:madam;.
It was Umi, wasn't it?! She's always playing jokes on me, and now she's got you in on it too!
Reporting for duty, sir.
Just in... another batch of Darkmoon Special Reserve.  Come get yours before they're all gone!
DIE?! You make Pusillin cry!

If you remember but one thing, know this: not even death can stop the Light.

This we have in common with all Forsaken--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own fear us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.

In truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but we are not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.

Then they will see our nature.
I believe I noticed a new shipment of mail being delivered not too long ago.  You'll find the mailbox just outside the Thunder Bluff Bank on the lower rise.
Thank you for helping me. I know my way back from here.
Be on your guard, $n!

A staple of the Thorium Brotherhood.$B$BArcanite crystals are harvested from rich thorium lodes. Through the alchemical prowess of powerful alchemists, arcanite bars are born.$B$BSeek out a miner, if you aren't one... and find a good alchemist! You'll need both.
The good doctor saves the day! HOORAY!
If tailoring is your thing, Vizzklick will most definitely have your supplies. Take a look around, $n, and let me know if you wish to purchase something!
Help me kill $n!
We must move quickly. Auberdine isn't too far away, but many enemies lurk in the forest.
Your time has come, $n. Master Kang awaits...
